method.snapshot_rule: All baseline repository observations are pinned to audit_snapshot_commit unless explicitly marked live-executor observation.
method.truth_rule: File or directory existence is evidence of a durable artifact only; terminal success, integration, usefulness and human acceptance require their own explicit evidence.
method.unknown_rule: Missing or incomplete denominators remain UNKNOWN/null rather than becoming zero, percentages or inferred success/failure.

useful_durable_results_per_human_interve.reason: The repository has no complete canonical human-action ledger for the comparison population. Chat count is not a valid substitute.

automatic_next_wave_ratio.reason: Generated queues exist, but legacy/current opportunity provenance is not complete enough to classify the full denominator as automatic versus manual without guessing.

integration_latency.reason: A RETURN artifact is not an integration-complete timestamp. At the snapshot, the Page Thread Bridge had a RETURNED_CANDIDATE while its same recovery run was still STARTED, so return publication cannot be used as terminal integration completion.

stale_rate.reason: One stale orphan is proven and recovered by this run, but a global stale percentage requires normalized attempt denominator and pinned policy evaluation for every claim/run lineage.

duplicate_collision_and_recovery.finding: Non-atomic overlap preflight is insufficient under concurrent recovery allocation.
duplicate_collision_and_recovery.interpretation: Both recovery allocators could truthfully observe no active overlap before their own write, then both persist. The invariant therefore needs an atomic durable fence/create-if-absent key or equivalent ownership primitive, not only read-then-write overlap checks.

per_root_return_artifact_coverage.denominator_rule: Seven staged surface lanes per root: DISCOVER, INTENT, PLAN, REUSE, RISK, TRUTH, UX.
per_root_return_artifact_coverage.caution: These counts prove return-artifact coverage only. They must not be reported as terminal throughput until same-run terminal state and required integration disposition are verified.

route_changing_findings.finding: The metrics pipeline must join claim/recovery/run/return/integration semantics. Counting paths alone overstates progress when RETURN exists before terminal run closure or integration.
Recovery overlap checks based on preflight reads are raceable. The observed 29-second dual Kernel recovery claims require atomic fencing/ownership semantics at persistence time.

deduplicated_next_work.action: Feed this pinned runtime audit into the existing compiler/integrator contract; do not create a second metrics compiler. Preserve UNKNOWN for incomplete human/provenance denominators and distinguish RETURN_DURABLE from RETURN_INTEGRATED.

Treat the dual Kernel recovery claims as a falsifier for caller-supplied read-then-write overlap checks. Any follow-up should extend the existing lease/retry owner with an atomic durable recovery fence or explicitly document why repository primitives cannot provide it; do not duplicate the lease/retry subsystem.
